content.what_it_is: Preprocessed (build/pre) residue of a FUNWAVE-TVD optional module: comment lines only — L1-L11 blank, L12-L55 Simplified BSD license header (FILE mod_subgrid.F @L14), L57 description 'TIDE_MODULE is a module to add tide/surge boundary conditions into wave simulation', HISTORY 07/28/2022 Fengyan Shi @L60, closing marker '! end subgrid' @L62. No MODULE statement, declarations, or executable code: the module body was excluded by the C preprocessor in this build (subgrid option off).

verbatim_spans.text: !  TIDE_MODULE is a module to add tide/surge boundary conditions into wave simulation

unresolved: Description @L57 names 'TIDE_MODULE ... tide/surge boundary conditions' while the file name (and FILE line @L14, end marker @L62) say subgrid — the header comment appears copied from a tide module; which module body this file originally held cannot be determined from this file
The entire module body is absent (preprocessor-excluded); only comments remain between L12 and L62
